title: Throughline-aligned default
notice: Throughline-aligned default. The discipline codes follow the Throughline `Discipline` code list where it has an entry (PIP, MEC, ELE, INS, CIV, STR; origin "throughline"). ARC, PLB, FPR, TEL and GEN are added (origin "added"); a crosswalk to a company code is suggested where one fits, because a Throughline project value must map to a company value. This list is a stand-in: load the project's actual `Discipline` code list (the company standards edition) in the Classify drawer to replace it.
